rows.title: Strength training intervention with creatine/whey protein supplementation vs placebo on frailty in older adults with cirrhosis (STRIVE): A Randomized Controlled Trial.

rows.title: Sarcopenia, unhealthy lifestyle, and vitamin D: A Mendelian randomization study.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mendelian-randomization evidence addresses genetically proxied exposure and is not equivalent to supplementation effects.

rows.title: The role of neuroinflammation in the connections between autism spectrum disorder and Alzheimer's disease and related dementias: A review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Narrative review; proposed preventive implications are primarily theoretical and indirect.

rows.title: Musculoskeletal decay and bone-muscle crosstalk during physical disuse: Mechanisms and integrated countermeasures.

rows.title: Dietary Patterns, Micronutrient Adequacy, and Metabolic Vulnerability in Alzheimer's Disease: A Critical Narrative Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Mostly observational and narrative evidence; correcting deficiency should not be represented as disease-modifying treatment.
